During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''scout vessel''' served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Fakir sector fleet]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was used to ambush [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lens Reekeene]]'s [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] while she was on route to a rendezvous with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Sector Command (Alliance)/Legends|high command]]. The [[Scout ship/Legends|scout ship's]] initial attack heavily damaged the X-wing's [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and eliminated Reekeene's [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]].<ref name="Missing" />

The [[Unidentified Imperial scout vessel captain|commander]] of the scout ship expected Reekeene to surrender, but she surprised the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] by counter-attacking, releasing a volley of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] at close range into the vessel. The scout ship was hit three times, and the [[Fuel pod/Legends|fuel pod]] was destroyed, although Reekeene's X-wing was disabled due to its close proximity to the explosions. The captain captured Reekeene, but due to the damage the ship had sustained, he was forced to divert the vessel to the abandoned [[Imperial garrison (Flankers)|garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Flankers]].<ref name="Missing" />
